campaign.source: Preserved research/proposal: SOURCE-PLAN-2026-09-20.md, copied with whitespace normalized from research/codkit-universal-fork-review-2026-09-20/03-synthesis-and-plan.md. Product contracts govern implementation; the source's architectural recommendations do not silently resolve its owner decision list.

baseline.fact: Worktree was created from 03d2cee and rebased to a9a11c7; main, origin/main and github/main agree on a9a11c7. Main is clean.

Initial machine-readable public-format catalogs: 0. Initial public-format compatibility gates: 0. Candidate: 1 catalog with 55 entries, 1 gate and 10 focused tests. Of 55 entries, 11 have explicit inherited-version or missing-version gaps.
The initial P0.1 inventory atom changed no production TypeScript, runtime output, consumer serializers or history fingerprints. Later contract atoms below intentionally add opt-in format transitions.

decisions.decision: Start with the P0.1 inventory. It exposes compatibility gaps without choosing config v3, trusted registry locations or organization licence semantics. Deferring all development until those decisions would lose the independently useful discovery/gate step.

Keep runtime validators and governing contracts authoritative. Catalog metadata records current behavior; assigning invented versions or automatically rewriting consumers is rejected. Revisit when implementing the source plan's migration atoms.

Use the installed TypeScript 7 scanner for a bounded static coverage tripwire; do not execute adapters. Its removed legacy compiler API prevents the old parser path. Dynamic/computed format conventions require explicit catalog/discovery fixtures; this gate is not a proof of arbitrary program behavior.

predictions.prediction: Existing consumer serialization and generated history remain byte-identical: this atom edits tooling, metadata and the npm development gate only.
Deleting a format policy, changing a numeric schema or deleting migration/test evidence makes the focused gate red.
The complete floor is already blocked on the base; catalog changes alone cannot make it green.

route.phase: Read the source proposal, inspect schemas and probe baseline gates; no commits. Complete.

Public-contract hardening: P0.1-P0.5 and P0.9 are implemented candidates. P0.7 package/publish receipts also pass the complete native floor; the delegated technical decisions and remaining owner boundaries are recorded below. Exit: exact existing fixture compatibility and complete project floor.

Licensing and release evidence: P0.10 and the evidence portion of P0.7. Trusted-policy/source/provenance/notice/SPDX and package/publish mechanism candidates pass the full native floor. Actual commercial policy rulings are not supplied by fixtures.
Local workspace lifecycle: P0.11; workspace pairs, unique refs and writer refusal.
Trusted external type supply: P0.3/P0.4 with a real partner; offline install, integrity and pre-import handshake proof.
Measured expansion with real consumers: codec seam P0.6, coordinator contract P0.8, build recipe design P0.12; new implementation follows its polygon.

current-atom.perimeter: Named local workspace pairs: patchset task worktree, fork worktree, stable workspace ID/ref namespace, type/pin, owner/session metadata and launcher resolution.
current-atom.acceptance: Create/list/show/finish/remove operate on isolated real Git worktrees. One writer per physical patchset checkout; no writing task shares a patchset checkout. Generated refs include stable workspace ID; build daemons retain workspace/tree ownership. Named selection supplies resolved roots through where and refuses conflicting root flags. Finish proves save/clean state before cleanup. Preserve legacy selection/refs when no workspace is selected, run the complete native floor.
current-atom.negative-proof: Alias checkout writer collisions, duplicate names/IDs/ref namespaces, foreign roots/records, dirty or unsaved finish/remove, live writers/daemons and root-flag escape refuse without destroying work.
current-atom.safe-stop: 50dddd2 adds physical checkout writer capabilities with full native suite 2809 passed/four existing skips. No process remains live. Next: named workspace pair registry/create/list/show/finish/remove, guarded root selection and UUID ref namespaces; do not fabricate legal/signing/external-partner/consumer approvals.

campaign.quick-start: git status --short git log --oneline -3 npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund npm run formats:check npm run typecheck npm run runtime:check npm run trace:check npm run docs:check npm run floor
campaign.whole-campaign-acceptance: Each later phase supplies its source-plan polygon and a green complete floor. This first atom does not establish type ABI, trusted external supply, licence evidence, discipline, workspaces or multi-component release acceptance.

review-points.open: The owner delegated unattended development on 2026-10-03. Reversible technical defaults follow the source proposal and are recorded in product contracts; commercial legal rulings, signing custody and a real external-type partner remain external boundaries. The source decision inventory is the eight numbered items in the source plan's “Решения владельца перед кодированием”: Git boundary, discipline axis, schema migration, component/coordinator split, registry/policy trust, runtime inclusion, commercial notice ruling, signing and type namespace ownership. Inventory work does not ratify them.

execution-ledger.entry: P0.11 witnessed inputs 2f0054c: actual workspace delivery writes strict external codkitWorkspaceInputDelivery:1 binding workspace/tree path and complete existing input snapshot. Receipt keys include the full canonical mapping so distinct rebuilt outputs remain distinct immutable witnesses. Workspace cache reuse needs matching external evidence; absent/mismatched evidence rebuilds rather than granting Git-admin hints cleanup authority, and malformed/future witness data refuses. Every delivered backing blob gets a UUID-scoped immutable non-head ref. Finish requires unchanged copies and witnessed cache identity; material v3 binds blob/ref/content, input name/stamp and sealed config digest. Removal checks declared destination, saved config and retained blob/type/content against current bytes, allowing source-independent retry and retaining blobs after both checkouts disappear. Strict v1/v2 material receipts reject input kinds, with no implicit rewriting or legacy unselected input behavior change. New tests prove post-removal blob access, changed input and missing ref refusal, and forged cache stamp refusal. Initial new cases lacked runSync inputs:working and therefore exercised no delivery; corrected setup now performs the real declared input build. Final offline non-root Linux twenty-eight-file inputs/LFS export/material/overlay/lifecycle/daemon/CI/cycle/CLI/writer/contained-I/O regression passes 341/341, catalog 72/11, 98 receipts, typecheck, 289-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native floor green with eight frozen/zero new findings and 1501 spec units, retaining the existing zero-code extraction warning. This is scoped evidence; latest whole suite remains 2835 passes/four existing skips. Build outputs and retained logs, named cycle/publish proof and the complete final Phase 3 gate/audit remain open.

P0.11 material receipt v2 fa2f6f2: strict v1 remains unchanged, while explicit v2 admits hydrated LFS and exact anchored empty-directory entries. Saved LFS pointers/committed attributes are resolved in the existing isolated attribute oracle with no local info/attributes or machine authority; current payload hash/size and backing bytes in the source common repository LFS store must agree. The private oracle directory is canonically verified before cleanup. Empty directories require a saved own placeholder/manifest anchor and must still be empty at deletion; extra data refuses, and no whole prefix is authorized. Only captures requiring new kinds emit v2; future formats and new kinds in v1 refuse. Actual fixture LFS filters demonstrate that Git status can recreate an absent backing object while source checkout data remains, so the negative proof now removes the patchset worktree first, then loses the backing object and verifies the remaining fork is preserved until restoration/retry. Local info/attributes without committed LFS authority refuses. Final exact offline non-root Linux twenty-six-file LFS export/material/overlay/lifecycle/daemon/CI/cycle/CLI/writer/contained-I/O regression passes 320/320; catalog 71/11, 98 receipts, typecheck, 288-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native floor pass with eight frozen/zero new findings and 1500 spec units, retaining the existing zero-code extraction warning. This is scoped proof, not a complete-suite rerun or Phase 3 acceptance. The backing check uses the standard common-repository LFS store, consistent with the existing export mechanism. Inputs, build outputs, retained logs, named cycle/publish and final complete gate/audit remain open.

P0.11 saved material cleanup d6eb1f4: strict external codkitWorkspaceMaterials:1 binds workspace ID and exact existing finish proof without widening registry/checkout/config schemas. Declared own-source/extension copies must match regular blobs of the sealed patchset commit. The local dev-channel sidecar must equal the shared read-only overlay renderer, with config/overlay inputs matching saved blobs; retained text/digests authorize no arbitrary neighbouring paths. Receipt publication is exclusive/immutable, and removal rechecks saved source blobs and actual target hashes before exact cleanup. Common-repository source proof survives patchset-first deletion. Malformed/future/traversal receipts, source-map forgery, changed targets, ignored unsaved own work and unowned neighbours refuse. Initial regressions exposed the tool's empty .codkit/tmp and local manifest.overrides.json as unowned; workspace execution now prunes only its empty scratch directory and shares the dev-channel renderer rather than inferring ownership by filename. Legacy scratch behavior stays unchanged. Final offline non-root Linux twenty-four-file material/lifecycle/start/daemon/CI/cycle/overlay/CLI/argv/JSON/writer/contained-I/O regression passes 296/296; actual launcher load/fresh/finish/remove and interrupted patchset-first removal pass. Catalog 71/11, 98 type receipts, typecheck, 287-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native floor pass with eight frozen/zero new findings and 1499 spec units, retaining the existing zero-code extraction warning. This is scoped evidence; latest complete suite remains 2835 passes/four existing skips. Produced inputs, build outputs, retained daemon logs, empty declared materialization directories and LFS-backed source copies still need explicit ownership handling before Phase 3 acceptance, followed by named cycle/publish proof and the full final gate/audit.

P0.11 daemon/lifecycle serialization 64b53ea: explicit workspace starts take the same contained user registry generation lock as finish/removal before channel files, re-read active state by exact UUID, and hold the guard through reservation/spawn/final PID publication. Registry revision stays unchanged and the guard does not outlive startup. Finished/removed stale calls cannot recreate checkout roots. Unbound starts in paired checkout markers refuse instead of treating patchset data as authority. Privileged registry-root composition context is propagated through CI/snapshot config and omitted from serialization; registry warnings reach the caller. Exact UUIDs now take precedence over UUID-shaped names, while ID authorization never falls back to a name. Four deterministic real-Git barrier cases prove finish refusal before/after reservation and before PID publication, lifecycle-held refusal, stale finished/removed calls, unbound paired calls and identity/name-shadow refusal. Updated warning call-site assertions keep tree/warning binding and now include registry authority. Final offline non-root Linux eighteen-file lifecycle/daemon/CI/cycle/CLI/argv/JSON/writer/contained-I/O regression passes 204/204; catalog 70/11, 98 receipts, typecheck, 286-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native structural floor pass, eight frozen/zero new findings and 1498 spec units with the existing zero-code extraction warning. This is scoped evidence; latest complete-suite proof remains the preceding daemon snapshot's 2835 passes/four existing skips. Saved-materialization/log cleanup and named cycle/publish/final Phase 3 audit remain open.

P0.11 daemon identity 2f1d6c4: ordinary strict codkitBuildDaemon:1 remains byte-compatible without a workspace field; explicit workspace context writes version 2 with required UUID plus existing tree ID/path and nonce. Unknown/missing/foreign-format identity refuses without migration. Starts/status/down/log reads bind workspace and physical tree before process probes, signals, retirement or log attribution; workspace calls do not adopt v1 and unbound calls do not adopt v2. CI/cycle composition explicitly propagates context; lifecycle daemon checks reject foreign/unbound records. Windows four new unit cases pass. A real launcher scenario starts a watcher in one pair, copies its packet into another and proves unknown/no foreign teardown while the first watcher remains living; its owner stops it in finally. Initial full Linux regression had three source-call-shape assertions stale after workspace fields/formatting; their mandatory warning/tree bindings were retained and workspace binding included. An obsolete Windows regression had failures and stalled in standing slow fixtures; its precisely identified test process was stopped and is not reported green. Final rebuilt offline non-root Linux full suite passes 227 files, 2835 tests, one file/four existing conditional cases skipped. Catalog 70/11, 98 type receipts, typecheck, 286-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native structural floor pass; eight frozen/zero new findings and 1497 spec units with the existing zero-code extraction warning. This proves explicit identity binding, not full daemon/lifecycle coordination: starts still need to serialize with finish/removal, saved-materialization/log cleanup and named cycle/publish acceptance remain open.

P0.11 named execution 8166980: --workspace selects an active name/UUID from user registry authority, verifies both real checkouts/receipts/canonical paths, bypasses ambient root settings/env and rejects explicit external root flags. Where reports the selected identity in its existing schema-2 data; the selecting CLI flag remains the source of both roots. Runtime-only configuration context derives applied/cycle/release UUID prefixes and preserves declaration prefixes separately; serialization strips context/restores declarations. Publisher immutable snapshots, CI comparison snapshots and cycle reloads explicitly inherit context. Fork drift exempts only the exact validated role receipt in the matching original checkout; finish additionally certifies only exact held lock-generation paths. Neighbouring human files remain dirty and fresh cleanup preserves the receipt. Disposable trees get no original receipt exemption. Real launcher proves named where, initial/repeated/fresh load into UUID refs, unchanged source/pair config, neighbouring work refusal and finish after applied delta; pure snapshot/serialization cases reject runtime context in persisted config. Final offline non-root Linux full suite: 226 files passed, 2830 tests passed, one file/four existing conditional cases skipped. Catalog 70/11, 98 type receipts, typecheck, 286-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native structural floor pass with eight frozen/zero new findings, 1496 spec units and the existing zero-code extraction warning. Phase 3 is still open: daemon workspace custody, safe removal of saved untracked materializations, named cycle/publish-specific proof and final integration/audit remain. Ordinary Git-tracked/receipt cleanup proof must not be mistaken for materialization cleanup acceptance.

P0.11 CLI 5edecdc: workspace create/list/show/finish/remove call the lifecycle libraries through the shipped launcher. Create requires explicit owner/session and an existing pair directory, optionally selects an immutable source ref, and refuses registry authority inside source repositories/Git administration. Registry inspection also refuses authority overlapping recorded checkout/repository/admin roots. Management takes no ambient external roots/settings and rejects explicit root flags; inspection imports no adapter. Before finish, actual patchset custody and the saved installed type declaration digest/contract are verified before adapter import/configuration. Missing registry inspection is inert and returns an empty versioned registry; absent arguments and unknown authority flags refuse. README and generated command reference describe actual commands. Exact offline non-root Linux ten-file launcher/argv/where/types/JSON/creation/finish/removal/writer/contained-I/O/linked-worktree regression passes 97/97; catalog 70/11, 98 type receipts, typecheck, 283-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native floor pass, eight frozen/zero new structural findings. This is scoped CLI evidence; the latest full suite remains the preceding lifecycle snapshot's 2821 passes/four existing skips. Named launcher selection, operational UUID refs and daemon ownership remain pending; Phase 3 is not accepted.

P0.11 lifecycle backend bc445fc: finish preserves immutable heads and clean/save proof while holding both checkout writer capabilities; dirty/unextracted history, stale generated evidence, foreign receipts and live/unresolved daemons refuse. Removal requires that finish proof and unchanged heads, rejects unowned physical paths including ignored files and empty directories, and retains both heads in UUID-scoped repository refs before journaling removing. Git force removal is limited to verified tracked data and owned receipt/cache/held lock generations; submodules and unknown data refuse. Checkout writer guards remain held through deletion. Interrupted deletion resumes only with absent Git registration and matching retained refs; removed repeats are inert. Eight real Git lifecycle cases prove baseline finish, dirty/foreign/live refusal, preserved ignored/empty data, changed heads, retained refs and partial-removal retries. The first verification snapshot raced native specmap generation and correctly failed trace; a rebuilt stable snapshot passed the complete offline non-root Linux suite: 224 files passed, 2821 tests passed, one file/four existing conditional cases skipped. Catalog 70 with eleven tests, 98 type receipts, typecheck, 281-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native structural floor pass; eight frozen/zero new findings, 1491 spec units with the existing zero-code extraction warning. This is backend proof, not Phase 3 acceptance: CLI, named launcher selection, operational ref namespaces and daemon ownership still remain.

P0.11 creation backend: strict user registry/checkout-receipt formats bind stable UUID, case-insensitive name, creating/active lifecycle, two real Git repositories/common dirs/paths, task branch/detached pin, type manifest digest and owner/session. Registry updates hold a contained atomic generation lock and compare raw bytes before writes. Creation reserves journal before mutation and makes active only after actual Git worktree/branch/receipt proof. Same-owner/session retry resumes a partial first-worktree creation with unchanged receipt; moved directory custody, foreign session, changed checkout work, unsafe source/registry placement and duplicate/future identities refuse without deletion or overwrite. Source and new checkout config bytes are unchanged; UUID namespace function is present but operational application/CLI remain open. Windows Git fixture timeouts are recorded as failures, not hidden. Exact offline non-root Linux workspace/writer/contained-I/O/linked-worktree subset passes four files/56 tests, catalog 70/11, receipts/typecheck/279-file runtime/trace/docs/supply and native structural floor green; eight frozen/zero new findings. This is scoped proof, not full-suite or Phase 3 acceptance. Next: finish/remove custody and clean/save/daemon proof, named launcher roots and ref namespace, CLI create/list/show/finish/remove, then full floor.

P0.11 writer custody 50dddd2: acquireLock now owns an exclusive physical patchset checkout guard alongside the unchanged per-tree generation. Different fork IDs, same-process independent scopes and directory aliases cannot overlap; separate checkouts remain independent. Nested cycle scopes borrow only an issued active same-checkout parent capability, guard survives all parent/child references and failed reservations unwind. Copied/released/foreign capabilities, already-live legacy owners, unknown foreign lock owners and nonregular lock files refuse. The lower-level stale-generation race/release proofs remain intact. This coordinates participating Codkit writers and detects already-live old owners; it does not control arbitrary uncooperative programs. Fixtures now forward parent capabilities; GC read-only planning still keeps live owners, while command mutation waits until checkout custody is released. Initial full run exposed these fixture forwarding/GC expectation gaps; they were corrected without permitting implicit PID-based borrowing. Final offline non-root Linux full suite: 222 files passed, 2809 tests passed, one file/four existing skips; format 68/11, receipts, typecheck, 277-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native structural floor green, eight frozen/zero new findings. Windows new writer cases pass; the existing two directory-symlink privilege cases remain EPERM and are not hidden. Named pair create/list/show/finish/remove, launcher selection/ref namespaces and workspace daemon ownership remain open; Phase 3 and the campaign are not accepted.

P0.10 integration 72b461b: fixed codkit.licensing.json selects profile/restrictions and separate operation mappings without patchset policy authority. Package gates actual source/provenance/canonical documents/carriers before restoration, then compares final outputs and declaration/store receipts. Publish validates the selected regular Git blob and snapshot bytes with the original patchset trust boundary; a temporary shaped-tip export is checked before real push/export, including hydrated LFS. A complete Git delivery has one root notice, not redundant subdirectory notices. Descriptor seals organization policy and actual distribution receipts; absent declarations retain explicit incomplete legacy evidence. Real fixture-backed package and configured official generic publish complete receipts pass; stale/lost evidence, moved stores/decls, root shadow and partial publication refuse. The generic component is explicitly synthetic, not external partner/legal approval. Initial full runs exposed two fixture/surface issues and the Git notice grouping defect; all were fixed without weakening guards. Final offline non-root Linux full suite: 221 files passed, 2803 tests passed, one file/four existing conditional cases skipped. Catalog 68/11 tests, 98 type receipts, typecheck, 276-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native structural gates pass with eight frozen/zero new findings. Windows standing Git-fixture slowness caused timeouts and is not reported as green. Phase 1/2 technical mechanism candidates are green; next P0.11 local workspace lifecycle, with actual commercial/signing/real partner/consumer evidence still external.

P0.10 documents d9bcd15: deterministic version-1 notice and strict SPDX-2.3 owned export bind policy/store/additional restrictions, payload path/checksum, source/carrier/origin and exact controlled license texts. Every used standard license/exception now requires trusted standardLicenseTexts; missing text refuses instead of treating an ID as an attached notice. Profiles omitting this optional field retain previous parsed bytes. Finalized metadata does not enter its own content hash, avoiding NOTICE/SBOM cycles, but final inventory still captures it. Explicit UTC creation time and content-derived namespace are stable; file-level copyright/in-file licensing are not invented from source. Attached documents require exact expected UTF-8 bytes and unchanged payload. External string-version catalog proof freezes SPDX-2.3 without inventing a numeric Codkit version. Windows document/policy focused tests pass; exact offline non-root Linux fourteen-file distribution/consumer/supply/CLI/Python-reference regression passes 154/154, catalog 67 with eleven gate tests, receipts/typecheck/275-file runtime/trace/docs/supply and native structural floor green; eight frozen/zero new findings. Generated private fixture also passes the official SPDX v2.3 JSON Schema (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/spdx/spdx-spec/v2.3/schemas/spdx-schema.json; SHA-256 239208b7ac287b3cf5d9a9af23f9d69863971102a5e1587a27a398b43490b89b). Mechanism fixtures are not commercial approvals. Phase 2 release/config selection, source-carrier enforcement and complete-suite acceptance remain open.

P0.10 provenance: strict declaration/report formats map every actual delivered payload once to freshly inspected source/carrier/REUSE evidence. Metadata exclusions require trusted composition approval and actual delivered regular files. Full source AND/OR/WITH expressions cannot be rewritten, and compound expressions require explicit policy approval. Source/header/registry/artifact bytes, policy/store/additional restrictions and declaration snapshots bind the receipt; before/after source/artifact inspections refuse changes. Consumer third-party origin comments must be nonempty and foreign copyright holders agree with the registry; origin bytes are no longer omitted from receipts. Fixtures prove mechanism only, not compilation or legal approval. Windows twelve consumer/provenance tests and exact offline non-root Linux thirteen-file 148-test provenance/notice/artifact/contained-I/O/consumer/supply/CLI/argv/Python-reference regression pass. Format catalog 65, type receipts, typecheck, 274-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native structural gates pass; eight frozen/zero new findings. This remains scoped evidence; canonical NOTICE content, SPDX export and package/publish/config enforcement remain open.

P0.10 attachment receipt 7c826a9: actual declared output bundles require every selected policy notice at the directory root, or as separately declared sibling output for file artifacts. Source-only, nested/other-bundle, empty/non-UTF-8 notices, empty/notice-only payloads and falsely complete reports refuse. Exact notice path/bytes, policy digest and before/after artifact inventory bind codkitDistributionNotices:1; notice re-reads confirm byte stability. This establishes named attachment, not approval of notice content or complete distribution enforcement. Windows five new tests pass; offline non-root Linux twelve-file notice/artifact/contained-I/O/consumer/supply/CLI/argv/Python-reference regression passes 143/143. Catalog 63, receipts, typecheck, 273-file runtime/trace, docs, supply and native structural gates pass with eight frozen/zero new findings. Remaining: approved-content/provenance binding, source carrier requirement, selected SBOM export and package/publish enforcement; Phase 2 remains active.

P0.10 CLI eef75b6: license consumer-check requires explicit source and --profile, reads only fixed user organization-policies.json, and needs the independently resolved patchset root to reject a store inside it. No config/fork/adapter or patchset authority fields are consumed. Real launcher proves complete/incomplete report exit codes, missing trusted store despite patchset shadow, store-inside-patchset refusal and explicit invocation/unknown authority-flag refusal. Long command names now retain two help separator spaces. Windows new CLI passes four tests; offline non-root Linux nine-file consumer/supply/CLI/argv/Python-reference regression passes 110/110 with format, receipts, typecheck, 272-file runtime/trace, docs, supply kit and native structural gates green; eight frozen/zero new findings. Final UTF-8 documentation correction passes local docs checks. Whole-suite Phase 2 acceptance, config-selected release policy and artifact NOTICE/SBOM enforcement remain open.

P0.10 consumer scanner bfb8cca: shared unchanged default carrier selection preserves Codkit supply behavior, while contained consumer reads and separately selected organization authority check own/foreign holders, exact SPDX expressions and source/carrier byte digests. Own sidecars/override annotations cannot erase upstream header ownership; mixed copyrights, missing provenance annotations, disagreement, undeclared references, orphan sidecars and source symlinks refuse. Windows policy/consumer subset passes 24 tests; exact offline non-root Linux six-file policy/consumer/supply/Python-reference regression passes all 97 tests. Format catalog covers 62 entries with ten negative gate tests; type receipts, typecheck, 271-file runtime/trace, docs, supply kit and installed native structural floor pass, eight frozen/zero new findings. This is scoped regression evidence, not the full-suite Phase 2 acceptance. CLI policy selection and artifact NOTICE/SBOM enforcement remain open.

P0.10 authority foundation c98a461: strict organization policy/store schemas, trusted user/admin root selection separate from patchset, ID-only patchset selection with monotone additional prohibitions, exact approved expression combinations, controlled namespace LicenseRef with nonempty canonical text/SHA-256, NOASSERTION/future format refusal, and distinct own/third-party scope. The mechanism does not assert an actual legal ruling. Windows new-policy suite passes 17/17; existing supply tests encountered the standing file-symlink EPERM baseline. Exact offline non-root Linux policy/supply/reference subset passes all 90 tests in five files, including every Python-reference fixture, plus format (61 entries/10 coverage tests), receipt/typecheck/runtime/trace/docs/supply/native structural checks, eight frozen/zero new conform findings. Consumer scanning, CLI selection integration and artifact notice/SBOM enforcement remain open; this is not Phase 2 acceptance or a full-suite rerun.

P0.7 publish integration 860a8a4: the release capability captures the selected immutable patchset configuration and checked generated tip while the disposable checkout exists; shaped/squashed/orphan delivered Git objects are separate artifact facts. Successful ref/export delivery gets a deterministic historical delivery receipt; failed gates/collisions emit no successful descriptor, and failed local recording after delivery explicitly reports the delivered state rather than inventing rollback. Snapshot/type mismatch refuses before scratch/network mutation. Programmatic command contexts can supply a validated type declaration from their composition root; production defaults retain the trusted registry and test seams remain labelled fixtures. Final offline Linux complete suite: 213 test files passed, 2750 tests passed, one file/four existing conditional cases skipped; all format/receipt/typecheck/runtime/trace/docs/supply and installed native structural steps green, eight frozen/zero new findings. P0.1-P0.5/P0.9 and package/publish P0.7 are technical candidates with a green full gate. Phase 2 organization enforcement and actual distribution notices/SBOM remain open; missing legal/signing/partner inputs have not been fabricated.

P0.7 package integration b032664: public package release capability binds real Git objects, canonical effective config, validated manifest and fresh installed supply-policy bytes to recipe/artifact receipts; roots-derived component identity is stable across full-history clones and --component-id supports explicit/shallow identities. CLI returns immutable descriptor path/digest and honest missing organization-policy/notices/SBOM evidence. Capture precedes unconditional restoration; receipt publication follows restoration and a second artifact comparison, so overlapping scratch/overlay outputs cannot leave a stale success receipt. Before the final upstream-date/output comparison refinements, the complete offline Linux suite passed 2749 tests (four existing skips) and native structural floor. The exact final behavior passes the 28-test package/fact regression subset and all setup/format/receipt/typecheck/runtime/trace/docs/supply/native structural gates; eight frozen findings, zero new. These are distinct scopes, not a claim that the final complete suite has rerun. Publish integration remains open; no phase/campaign completion claim.

P0.7 artifact capture 3127d85: files use SHA-256 through the same descriptor containment proof with a 64 KiB buffer and size/mtime/ctime stability checks. Directories bind sorted path/kind/mode/content receipts, including empty directories, to codkitArtifactTree:1; links hash their exact UTF-8 target text without following it, and escaping targets/parents refuse. Windows focused release/hash tests pass 19/19. An offline non-root Linux snapshot passes all 135 tests in the eight-file contained-I/O/release regression set, plus format (59 entries/10 tests), receipt, typecheck, runtime, trace, docs, supply checks and installed native structural floor with eight frozen/zero new findings. This is scoped regression evidence, not the full Vitest campaign or Phase 1 acceptance. Next: bind actual Git/config/type/recipe/policy facts and connect receipt emission to package/publish.

P0.7 foundation 74b726b: strict root-versioned component descriptor codec, semantic digest/commit/tree brands, deterministic sorting and SHA-256 sealing, typed failure results, and contained exclusive immutable storage. Seven focused tests prove canonical retries, changed-body digest refusal, future/noncanonical data refusal, evidence status/missing consistency including empty requirements, duplicate/path refusals, conflicting bytes preservation, parent substitution refusal and filename/body binding. Typecheck, 58-format catalog with 10 negative coverage tests, 263-file runtime and trace, docs and native conform (eight frozen/zero new) pass. This is not Phase 1 acceptance: package/publish does not yet emit the descriptor and real distribution evidence remains P0.10. Read-only discovery found existing nimbus consumer; external supplier/consumer and approved legal/signing references are requested asynchronously, with independent development continuing.

P0.9 implemented in 49f41d2: explicit config v4 accepts a missing human tag; operational keys use the full SHA and literal tag stamps stay empty. v2/v3 ordinary config bytes and tagged names remain unchanged. New resolutions record resolvedAt; optional provenance is declaration data, not authenticated evidence. Cycle state 3 and stabilization report 2 carry new evidence without widening old formats. CLI hard-crash recovery proves both tag and SHA paths through completion even after deleting the original Git tag. The final offline non-root Linux snapshot passes 208 test files, 2727 tests (one file/four existing conditional cases skipped), all format/receipt/typecheck/runtime/trace/docs/supply checks and the installed native structural floor with eight frozen findings and zero new. A final type-only restoration of PinConfig readonly fields passes current typecheck and the 262-file runtime comparison. Negative journal tests reject new pin evidence in old state/report versions.
